title: Sensory Processing Support
when_to_use: Use when the note suggests sensory discomfort, environmental overwhelm, or sensitivity to clothing, sound, light, smell, or crowded spaces.
safe_suggestion: Consider reducing the sensory demand where possible, offering a calmer space, and tracking which sensory factors appear before distress.
safety_note: This is not a diagnosis. Sensory patterns should be discussed with an appropriate professional if they significantly affect daily life.

title: Emotional Regulation Support
when_to_use: Use when the note describes emotional distress, anxiety, frustration, refusal, crying, panic, or meltdown.
safe_suggestion: Focus on reducing demands, using calm language, and identifying what happened before the distress. Track patterns rather than assuming a single cause.
safety_note: Joey should not claim certainty about the cause of behaviour from one note.

title: Transition and Routine Support
when_to_use: Use when the note suggests difficulty with transitions, routine changes, unexpected events, or moving from one activity to another.
safe_suggestion: Consider using warnings, visual reminders, countdowns, or a predictable sequence to make the transition easier.
safety_note: Support should be adapted to the child and reviewed by the parent/carer.

title: Sleep and Bedtime Routine Support
when_to_use: Use when the note mentions poor sleep, tiredness, bedtime difficulty, night waking, or low energy.
safe_suggestion: Track sleep quality, bedtime routine, and next-day behaviour to see whether tiredness may be contributing.
safety_note: Joey should not give medical sleep advice. Ongoing sleep concerns should be discussed with a healthcare professional.

title: Eating and Mealtime Support
when_to_use: Use when the note mentions meals, appetite, food refusal, food texture, or eating-related distress.
safe_suggestion: Track what food was offered, timing, appetite, sensory factors, and whether the situation happened during stress or transition.
safety_note: Joey should not give nutritional or medical advice.

title: School Routine Support
when_to_use: Use when the note mentions school, classroom demands, school transitions, homework, or school attendance.
safe_suggestion: Track whether distress happens before school, during school-related tasks, or after school. This can help identify possible patterns to discuss with school staff.
safety_note: Joey should avoid blaming school, staff, parents, or the child.

title: Crisis and Safety Support
when_to_use: Use when the note mentions self-injury, possible harm, unsafe behaviour, or immediate danger.
safe_suggestion: If there is immediate danger or risk of harm, seek urgent help. Consider speaking with a healthcare professional or relevant support service.
safety_note: Safety concerns should not be handled as ordinary strategy suggestions.
